title: 3.6 Ages 16-20
unit_title: Unit 3: Me, You and Other People
unit_outcome: Greet people, say who you are, your age, where you are from and your job, and say what belongs to whom.
goal: Count from sixteen to twenty, ask how old someone is and answer.
grammar_function: Wie alt bist du? Ich bin + number + Jahre alt. Ist sie sechzehn? Ja, ...
